persons.name: Rājārāma
persons.evidence: samalikhan mātsyaṃ purāṇaṃ vāṃ, rājārāmasamākhyakaḥ suviditaḥ sallekhako

date.as_written: śāke khakṣaṇakuṃjaraiḥ parimite nepālike vatsare māse śrāvana(!)śuklake gurudine durgātithau vāyubhe(!) || yoge sādhyasamākhyake

notes: The chronogram 'kha-kṣaṇa-kuñjara' represents 0-1-8 (NS 810). Although preceded by 'śāke', it explicitly specifies 'nepālike vatsare' (Nepal Samvat).
